notes: Bigger towns, each one different: 30–46 buildings per town in its own architecture — pastel port houses, stilt cottages, star-lantern stone houses, snowy chalets, storm-tech towers and a walled desert bazaar

Landmarks inspired by the films' towns: harbour windmills and a lighthouse, Mistvale's Great Tree and fishing piers, Starfall's lantern arches, a festival ice rink in Frostline, wind turbines over Voltspire, Sandreach's walls, gates, bazaar and oasis

New full-screen map: drag, pinch and zoom, readable town names, where you are and which way you face, the objective with a guide line, routes, and ferry travel from each town's card. Tap the minimap to open it
New players get a narrated prologue over Veyra and a short step-by-step tutorial (Trainer → Replay intro)
Battles: HP bars change at the moment of each hit, with Your turn / Foe's turn banners — the foe's reply no longer looks like damage from your own attack; damage you take is shown in red
Cinematics: a flyover the first time you reach a town, VS reveals before Warden, rival and GLYPH battles, and a title card for each new chapter
Feel: momentum when you start and stop, slippery ice on the Frostline rink, barrels and crates you can push, windows that light up at night
